process: The author keeps opening new physics ideas (paper sheets in PrintSim, the glass sea, the stomp, glass rain) and posting first takes that fail. Meanwhile litter from earlier features (ring balls, an opaque ghost double, square snow, a sand heap) piles up in the live game the human sees, and the ring balls have doubled since 124. Goal 1 (interactions): little movement; the skate scratches are not visible. Goal 2 (release): three releases on 23-24 Nov, nothing since. Goal 3 (physics): real progress underneath (air drag in PrintSim, a tumbling page live), but nothing a player can touch yet, and the paper sim NaNs on contact. Goal 4/7 (rendering, materials): the glass sea is the first convincing path-traced material moment; the rest is still plastic. Goal 5 (Lumi's garden): the yellow bird body has character, but Lumi is bored and the 'New on the island' line is stale. Goal 6 (animation): the beak snap and judder are still there. Goal 8: plenty of wild ideas, few finished. Next: spend one session cleaning the island (ring, ghost, snow), then finish and film the glass sea properly, frost growing and scratches catching the sun, as a traced short people would share.

animation.why: live_motion: Lumi's beak jumps 0.22 m in one frame at 6.5 m/s; Lumi's body, face and wing and Pinchy's body judder (40-52% unevenness); Sir Sniffsalot is frozen solid. The glass-sea films have one hard pop at 1.25 s where the whole sea swaps material.

camera.why: The follow camera at 10:55 sat in a flowerbed facing nothing, then framed Lumi plus its ghost through a pine. The orbit and free views frame the island well but the sky is full of balls. The glass-sea film is a locked-off shot that ends with Lumi's body filling the lens.

creatures.why: The pigs, sheep, crabs and Gloop look good close up. Lumi now has a feathery yellow bird body with presence, but yesterday's ghost of it is drawn opaque and full colour, so the player sees two Lumis. The crab's party hat still sits off its shell (down from 6).

fun.why: Berry race works and the HUD is readable (score, time, where the berry is), but the test suite now fails it: rivals stay in :invite at the start. Jump-in has a huge list of keys (E X H G C P T B J U), which is a fun toybox, but none of them got new feedback this time.

lighting.why: A warm late-morning sun with good shadows in the raster. The traced orbit still at 10:59 is still one sun under a sky. The glass-sea film's low sun on a mirror sea is the best light so far, but no point, area or glowing light was seen live. Noise in the live trace.

materials.why: The glass sea is a real step: glossy dark water reflecting the tree and the crabs. The rest is still plastic: a pond of pale blue speckle in the trace, white stepping stones like untextured discs, the TV a brown box, and ring balls in plain matte colours.

performance.why: Frame median 4.2 ms, p95 7.5 ms, 30 fps, every system under 0.5 ms.

props.why: Plenty of generated assets (mushrooms, cottage, easels with real paintings, fences, flowers), well grouped near the cottage. The eye-level view is dominated by flat white stepping stones.

style.why: The soft clay-toy look holds for creatures and plants, but leftovers break it: matte ring spheres, square snow tiles, a sand heap with black spikes, an opaque ghost double.

ui.why: Clean panel, but 'New on the island: My day falls over and sings' has been stale for several sessions. The message is cut mid-sentence ('it heaved the'), and the speech label on Sir Sniffsalot reads 'Feeling a bit FLACKY today' over a garbled glyph.

world.why: Rich meadow, pond, cottage, pines, pier, easel gallery. Spoilt by litter from old features: 50+ ring balls in every sky (more than at session 124), a yellow sand heap with black teeth in the middle of the meadow, snow in square tiles with a huge snowman ball during the race.

wow.why: Of the last 8 posts, 4 are failed or broken takes (two stomp takes, glass rain 'not yet', the paper letter that breaks). 'The sea froze' is the only new picture, and it is a dark sea people walk on. A stranger would share almost none of these (down from 4).

summary: The island is dense and charming from above, and the glass-sea film finally shows something only a path tracer gives you: a dark mirror sea with real reflections of the friends. But the live game is cluttered with leftovers from old experiments: more than fifty ring balls fill every sky, yesterday's ghost Lumi walks beside today's as an opaque double, and the follow camera ends up buried in flowers. The last eight posts include four failed or broken takes, and the newest film is a 48-byte file.
